Name: Add TV Channel - Traveling Cart Schedule
Author: 4KMong
Description:
[b]Why I Made It
[/b]I like the vanilla vibe and didn’t want a big HUD overlay—but in busy Year 1 I kept forgetting Fri/Sun and missing the cart. This mod adds a in-game reminder instead of more on-screen clutter.

[b]How It Works
[/b]On cart days, check the TV in the morning. A new channel plays a short, static-laced line you can overhear. No tooltips, no icons—just watch. The broadcast doesn’t explain anything. It’s just garbled chatter about selling things and telling you to come somewhere. If you happen to hear that broadcast, take it as your cue: it’s a Traveling Cart day!

[b]Notes : Credits / AI Disclosure[/b][b]

[list]
[*]This mod was made with help from ChatGPT.
[/list][/b] ﻿﻿: I’m not a C# or Content Patcher﻿ expert; anyway it just works ;D

[list]
[*]It’s built on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24278]Custom TV Channel framework[/url]—I followed the creator’s example docs to put it together.
[*]The localization structure is inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28182]Gossip Girl TV[/url]﻿ mod.
[/list][list]
[*]English is the base text, but I actually tested Korean more.
[/list]
[b]Known Quirk
[/b]I couldn’t get the channel title to change.
(It seems some other mod authors are running into the same issue. This is beyond my coding level, so I hope someone publishes a better mod.)
Enjoy—and may your “Gotoro black-market rumors” always arrive on time.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Personal Note
[/b]Alright, to be honest, I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4779]Daily Screenshot[/url], but the tooltips kept getting captured in the screenshots, so I decided to disable UI Info Suite 2, but I still wanted to keep just the Traveling Cart alert.... so the moment I saw Custom TV Channel framework, it hit me that this would be the cleaner solution.

[b]Permission & Reuse
[/b]Anyone is welcome to modify or overhaul this mod and republish it however they like—you don’t need my permission. Frankly, it’d be better if someone who actually knows modding (or has a stronger concept) built and released it. I only put the idea out there because it seemed like no one else was doing it.
[i](If someone does end up making it, please leave a post so I can use it too.)[/i]
